annotations.title: Find and import a Summer asset

description:
Search the Summer asset library, import the best match into the project and, for a 3D model, add it to a scene. Needs the Summer sign-in. For an exact asset use summer_import_asset_by_id.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/import-asset"}

parent.description: Parent node path to add the asset under, e.g. './World'. If omitted, only imports (no scene placement)

query.description: What to find, e.g. 'low-poly tree', 'wooden crate'

scenePath.description: Required with parent. Exact res:// target scene path.

name: summer_import_asset
title: Find and import a Summer asset
